Hi Evelyn / Laura,

Please see attached invoice INV-8893 for the March services run. Our AP team is planning to settle this by bank transfer next week and we need confirmation on a couple of things before we raise the wire:

1) We were asked to route to Redwood's centralized USD collection account (per our shared onboarding). Can you confirm the exact beneficiary tagging you want on the payment so your reconciliation picks this up cleanly (entity name, internal reference)?

Oakridge is a UK-registered VAT payer; the vendor entity on the invoice reads "Redwood Inference Ltd" (Ireland entity details were provided earlier). Please advise which entity and VAT ID to reference.

Attaching the invoice and a sample remittance template — we can share a SWIFT copy once the payment is made.

Thanks,

Hi Kerry — thanks for the note and the invoice. Quick answers up front and a couple of clarifying Qs so we give the right bank string:

High-level options (and our preferred path):
- Option A (preferred): Pay EUR to Redwood Inference Ireland Ltd (EUR IBAN). No FX, straightforward reconciliation, and reverse-charge can be applied for B2B EU/Ireland <-> UK if the VAT rules apply.
- Option B: Pay into our USD centralized collection account (your bank converts or you instruct an FX). This introduces correspondent/intermediary fees. If you choose this, please instruct OUR to ensure we receive the full gross amount; otherwise fees will be netted by the banks and we'll need a SWIFT copy to reconcile and credit back agreed fees.
- Option C: Pay EUR but route to our USD pool (bank-side conversion). Similar intermediary risks as Option B.

Clarifying Qs
- Which Redwood legal entity is on the invoice header? (I see Redwood Inference Ltd on INV-8893 — is that the Ireland entity?)
- Are you able to push OUR on your wire? If not, let us know and we'll accept SHA but will need a SWIFT trace to reconcile any shortfalls.

I'll ask Laura to send formal bank strings and VAT ID for the Ireland entity. Marcus, can you prep the treasury note on the "credit for correspondent fees" policy so Kerry can see the threshold/requirements?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
